title: bev_fusion: camera + radar BEV system in five layers
subtitle: Built 2026-11-01 as a five-layer design, updated 2026-11-21 (student image encoder, recursive one-frame / one-scan input, fusion-area masks). Left of the input interface nothing learns; between the two interfaces every slot is a swappable block chosen in ModelConfig (one builder table per slot, tests/test_slots.py) with no rule step; right of the output interface only the selection of boxes and line cells for the metrics, and later the planner.

pre.label: precompute: deterministic, cached with an identity, no weights learned before it

interface.label: interface: one typed contract (names, shapes, units, frames)

nodes.label:
Cameras
window, or one frame + state
nodes.note: default: the window of n_cam frames of the batch (cam_buffer 'window'); options (t21, D91): ONE frame per step with the past carried as the state of the previous step at BEV-feature level (cam_buffer 'pair' / 'recurrent'); today the front camera; six cameras are one more entry of the interface, not a new chain

nodes.label:
Radars
detections: 0.5 s or one sweep
nodes.note: all five radars; default: the sweeps of the last 0.5 s accumulated at point level; option radar_per_frame (t25, D91): ONE sweep per camera frame (batch['radar_seq'])

nodes.label:
Ego motion
poses / CAN
nodes.note: from the poses in nuScenes; a deployed system supplies its own odometry

nodes.label:
Image features
frozen encoder, cached
nodes.note: frozen DualBEV / BEVFusion image heads: depth probabilities + context per pixel; while frozen they are a cache (with a meta.json identity), once unfrozen the image encoder becomes the first network slot (the optional student encoder of the camera slot, t22 / t26, is that step)

nodes.label:
Radar points to now
pose + Doppler, cached
nodes.note: the sweeps of 0.5 s compensated to the current time and cached as points (not as a grid): the radar slot keeps the choice of raster or point encoder

nodes.label:
Ego steps, calibration
(dt, v, omega), K, T
nodes.note: the ego step from every past frame to now (dataset, from the poses), calibration and crop, the radar poses, and the ego steps to the neighbouring keyframes (batch['gap_steps']: the true gap to the target time and the memory step between calls, from the poses; train.batch_ego / clip_step read them, so the network runs without GT)

nodes.label:
INPUT INTERFACE
BEVInputs (typed dict + check): image features, lane image, K, T, ida, radar points, ego steps, gaps, flip
nodes.note: BEVInputs = the batch dict with its contract in interface.INPUTS (names, shapes, units, frames) and check_inputs(); the forward arguments dts, state, step, ego in interface.CALL; the per-sample flip flag travels with it (the mirror is a BEV operation after the camera slot)

nodes.label:
Camera BEV encoder
lift + collapse; student (option)
nodes.note: contract: BEVInputs -> (BEVs (B, F, C_cam, X, Y), visibility (B, 1, X, Y)), mirrored in BEV for flipped samples (cached perspective features cannot be mirrored); kinds dualbev, bevfusion, dual; option camera_student (t22 stage B, t26): a small trained image encoder (StudentEncoder, EfficientViT-B1 or ResNet-18) replaces the cached teacher outputs of the current frame, with student_frames 'all' (t26) of every frame of the window, and can be trained on the task (student_trainable)

nodes.label:
Radar BEV encoder
raster | delta slots | pillars | off
nodes.note: contract: radar points -> (B, C_rad, X, Y); the raster is the first op, before any weight, so it costs no gradient; radar history is the sweeps inside the points (with radar_per_frame, t25: one sweep per camera frame, the past in the radar memory of the temporal block); kind delta_slots (radar_encoder.py, in the t16 / t20 chain): the lossless delta-coded slot raster (K = 3 exact slots per cell + remainder mean + count) and two convolutions, with a reconstruction side loss (radar_aux) whose weight decays to a floor

nodes.label:
Temporal fusion
per branch: camera, radar
nodes.note: the same block for both branches (TemporalFusion takes channels and grid); camera: window (default) or one buffered frame, pair / recurrent (cam_buffer, t21, D91), + world memory; radar: none by default (its 0.5 s history is in the points), the radar memory with the Doppler static gate (rad_temporal 'window_memory') and the per-frame recursion (radar_per_frame, t25) are options, not trained successfully so far; contract: (BEV now, past BEVs with their ego steps, state, step since the last call, coverage) -> (BEV, state); the re-centre is a whole-cell roll, the gradient passes; finding (tests/test_slots.py): with no past radar frames the window part and the velocity head of the radar block get no gradient, so the radar memory needs its own static gate (the measured Doppler) or past radar BEVs

nodes.label:
Fusion
concat | gate
nodes.note: contract: (camera BEV, radar BEV) -> (B, C_fuse, X, Y); modality dropout lives here (off when a sensor is off)

nodes.label:
BEV backbone + neck
ResNet + FPN | SECOND | CMX
nodes.note: contract: (B, C_fuse, X, Y) -> features S (B, C, X, Y), the optional 1x1 head reduction included; CMX replaces fusion and backbone together (a kind of this slot that takes both branch BEVs)

nodes.label:
Time mover
velocity + ego splat
nodes.note: the shared TimeMover: moves S to each target time dt (velocity head + ego splat) before both heads, gives v_hat at dt 0; with the motion block (t15, on in t16 / t20) the velocity field comes from M and the 1 x 1 velocity head is removed

nodes.label:
Map head (0.5 m)
layers per dt
nodes.note: contract: (S moved to dt) -> map probabilities (B, L, X, Y), the channels from the layer table (5 areas, 2 line masks + 2 distance fields, 3 dense objects); the aux heads read the branch BEVs, not S (training only)

nodes.label:
Object head
CenterPoint maps per dt
nodes.note: contract: (S moved to dt) -> heatmap, offset, size, yaw, velocity, moving maps; the refiner (option, off in the base chain) decodes top-k and matches the GT inside the training path: a rule step when it is on

nodes.label:
Planner (later)
after the system
nodes.note: a consumer of the output interface, not part of the system; the outputs are dense and differentiable, so a later joint training lets its loss flow back into the fusion

nodes.label:
OUTPUT INTERFACE
maps, object maps per dt, v_hat, features S, state
nodes.note: BEVOutputs = per dt the maps, the object maps, the dense boxes and the soft line map (interface.OUTPUTS_PER_DT / OPTIONAL_PER_DT, check_outputs), plus v_hat, the features S and the temporal state

nodes.label:
Line cells
threshold
nodes.note: thresholds the soft line map for the line metric; the metric's reference line_cells stays the definition and a test checks the two agree

nodes.label:
Select boxes
local max, top-k, threshold
nodes.note: ONE extractor: boxes_from_maps reads only the K peak cells of the head maps (vectorised, float64, the same _params as the dense output) and is what object_head.decode, model.boxes(), the evaluation adapter and the prototype call; select_boxes does the same on a dense output (planner side); extract.py's self-test checks both box by box against the plain per-box loop (6 mutants caught); 1.7 ms instead of 6.5 ms (decode) and 1.5 ms instead of 9.0 ms (model.boxes) per frame at 100 candidates, CPU

nodes.label:
Boxes, lines
metrics, prototype
nodes.note: the numbers, pictures, videos and timing of a run come through one front door, evaluation/evaluate.py RUN [--quant] [--qual] [--videos] [--time] [--all], which calls bev_suite.py; the 1 m centre-line head is scored as the layer centreline

nodes.label:
Ground truth
GtGenerator, cached
nodes.note: GT release v14 (front v13 + lane l6, merged under D83); the BEV trainer's cache is keyed by the front signature

nodes.label:
Datasets, caches
clips, mirror, scratch

Trainer + trainkit
slot tables, check_config
nodes.note: ModelConfig picks one kind per slot from the builder tables of model.py (LIFTS, COLLAPSES, TEMPORALS, RADARS, FUSIONS, BACKBONES); check_config refuses every unknown kind and unfitting combination in one place; since D48 train() builds model, loss and data and hands them to the project-independent loop autoresearch/trainkit (checkpoints with resume, EMA, clipping, the stop request), the probes of probe.py are its hooks

nodes.label:
Loss
BEVLoss + Kendall
nodes.note: one module: the Kendall weights and the cross-head terms (motion and time consistency, refine) stay together; heads declare their output keys; the terms per layer come from the layer table (area: BCE + overlap, polyline: dilated Dice + distance + direction, dense box); loss.hygiene_2026_11_02 switches the corrected terms of the 2026-11-02 findings

nodes.label:
Lane add-on (option)
stride 4, after temporal
nodes.note: reads the lane image, K, T, ida and the DualBEV depth of the current frame; its BEV is added to the camera BEV after the temporal block; mirrored on its own; off for new from-scratch base runs (D65, training/configs/t20_base_nol4.json); since t20 it also works on the dual camera features (it reads the first source's depth, K and crop and adds to the merged camera BEV): at 20 m a stride-16 image pixel is 0.57 m wide (more than a 0.5 m cell), a stride-4 pixel 0.14 m

nodes.label:
Soft extraction
peaks, box params, line map
nodes.note: built from today's decode and line extraction: per cell a peak weight (heatmap x exp(-beta (maxpool - heatmap))), the box parameters (centre with offset, size, yaw with a soft direction sign, velocity x sigmoid(moving)) and a soft line map (near-zero distance x soft local minimum); fixed math, differentiable

nodes.label:
Visibility maps
camera, radar fan, fusion area
nodes.note: the precompute step (precompute.py): vis_cam from calibration + grid (cached per calibration, the same function live), vis_radar = the radar fans of the calibrated poses (D36; GtGenerator.coverage.radar_cells, cached per rig), vis_fusion = camera x radar (D37: fusion results are scored there), radar_hits = cells with detections now (the radar memory's write mask), radar_static = the same weighted by the measured Doppler (the write mask with rad_static_gate); read by the network, the training (D36 loss masks) and the evaluation (scoring masks)

nodes.label:
Motion block M
velocity field, 3 levels
nodes.note: t15 joint form (ModelConfig.motion_block, on in t16 / t20): the velocity field from the current and the oldest camera BEV (ego-aligned) and the fixed radar raster (count, Doppler, ray, age) in a small pyramid (2 / 1 / 0.5 m, motion_strides), a zero-initialised update per level, every level returned as v_levels for deep supervision; the time mover takes its field from here, box_vel_from_field makes it the object head's velocity; gradient clipping of its own (grad_clip_split)

nodes.label:
1 m head (option)
centre-line
nodes.note: centreline_1m (D48, t20): one pyramid level down: a SemanticHead on the map head's moved state, average-pooled 2 x 2 (1 m cells); presence, truncated distance field and direction (cos, sin) of the centre lines, one row (centreline, polyline, 1m) of the layer table; targets are pooled from the 0.5 m GT, no new GT version; output sem_1m (B, C, X/2, Y/2); the modules are built so that the option leaves the initialisation of all others unchanged

nodes.label:
Layer table
name, kind, level
nodes.note: the layers of the map head as rows (name, kind area | polyline | dense_box, level 0.5m | 1m): the kind decides the channels, the target and the loss, so a new layer is a row, not new code; the map head, the 1 m head, the pooled targets and BEVLoss derive from it (losses.layer_spec); the old layouts are reproduced channel by channel (tests/test_layers.py)

nodes.label:
Split lists
small | large | xl
nodes.note: scene names only (small 60 / 10, large 428 / 82, xl 700 / 82), each with the GtGenerator version its caches were checked against; a config says "split": "large", Training check / run resolves it into train_scenes / val_scenes (the run's config.json holds the exact lists); net/prep/splits.py also writes runs/<id>/manifest.json (split, GT, code commit, card) and the results/<id>/split.json of a result package; gt_scenes.py turns the lists into the GT a run needs

groups.label: 3 network: one slot per block, the kind chosen in ModelConfig, a contract test per kind

not_drawn.training/train_motion_block.py: t12 experiment trainer of the motion block on a frozen, trained base model (the block itself is in the chain since t15, box Motion block M); not the main training
not_drawn.training/startable.py: tool: static checks, smoke config and start lines of a training config; no GPU, not part of the network
not_drawn.training/ab_timing.py: tool: in-process A/B step timer (two speed settings in one process, blocks A B | B A, paired interval); not part of the network
not_drawn.net/model/launch_saving.py: speed variants of the forward (D53 / D54: fused splat, one shared mover, sync-free forms, host copies), same arithmetic as the plain code and off by default; drawn as the plain boxes
not_drawn.training/distill_student.py: t22 stage A trainer of the student encoder (offline, against the cached teacher outputs); not part of the network
not_drawn.training/legacy: S1 single-sensor pipeline and the t4 DualBEV front; nothing in model / train / evaluation imports it
